headline: GTA 6 lands November 19, 2026
caption: GTA 6 countdown is on: Leonida awaits on November 19, 2026.
video_script: GTA 6 is almost here. Rockstar has locked the launch for November nineteenth, twenty twenty six, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. You are heading back to Vice City, in the sunny state of Leonida, with two leads, Lucia and Jason. Pre-loading opens on November twelfth. Are you ready? Comment your most hyped feature below.
